review_scope: Independent review of the resubmitted refresh after the round-1 rework, by the reviewer agent, not the writer. I re-fetched every primary source (registry dist-tags and version documents, @ai-sdk/react peer metadata, ai@4.3.19 export map, the 5.0/6.0/7.0 migration guides, the useChat reference, the GitHub REST API and the live previously published page), re-executed run_matrix.sh from scratch in this run's own $TMPDIR and diffed its summary.jsonl/probes.jsonl against the retained records (identical), and audited the corrected README, the exit-code table's source-file documentation, the schema dateModified vs lastmod pair and every article claim. The Writer did not approve this page.
